invariants.expression: x < 0 || x >= width || y < 0 || y >= height || cells[x][y] == cell
invariants.rationale: If the coordinates are in bounds, the assignment is performed, ensuring cells[x][y] == cell; otherwise, nothing is changed.

invariants.expression: cell == null || x < 0 || x >= width || y < 0 || y >= height || cells[x][y] == null || cells[x][y] == cell
invariants.rationale: If cell is null, or the assignment occurs, cells[x][y] should reflect the correct value, unless the coordinates are out of bounds.
If x is within bounds, then cells[x] access is safe and must be within cells' length.
If y is within bounds, cells[x][y] is a valid access, so y must be less than cells[x].length.

invariants.expression: x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height ? cells[x][y] == cell : true
invariants.rationale: On valid indices, the cell at the given coordinate should always be equal to the input cell after the method exits.
